summary: Re-test of BUG-251 WhatsApp fix and BUG-254 sonner toast fix. Both fixes VERIFIED PASS. Quick BUG-250 polling persistence re-verified PASS. Frontend compiles cleanly.

verification_details.BUG-251_whatsapp_hidden_on_aggregator: PASS — In Order View, aggregator OrderCards 40474/40475/40476/40477 have NO `whatsapp-payment-btn-{orderId}` testid. Testids present per card are limited to order-card-{id}, order-id-chip-{id}, print-kot-btn-{id}, agg-ready-btn-{id}. Cancel(X) also correctly hidden.
verification_details.BUG-251_whatsapp_regression_regular: PASS — Regular delivery OrderCard 892353 still exposes `whatsapp-payment-btn-892353` (verified True).
verification_details.BUG-254_sonner_toast: PASS — Clicking `agg-ready-btn-delivery-40474` triggers POST /api/v1/urbanpiper/orders-status-update returning 500 (stale ID). Sonner toast renders top-right with text 'Failed to mark ready — please retry'. Confirmed via `[data-sonner-toast]` querySelectorAll length=1 and visual screenshot (red toast with X close button). App.js L67-68 imports `Toaster as SonnerToaster from ./components/ui/sonner`, L192-193 mounts `<SonnerToaster position='top-right' richColors closeButton />` alongside shadcn Toaster.
verification_details.BUG-250_polling_persistence: PASS — All 4 aggregator cards (40474/75/76/77) still present after 75s wait (>1 poll cycle at 60s interval).

critical_code_review_comments: DashboardPage.jsx still exceeds 700 LOC guideline (2145 lines) — consider splitting adaptOrder helpers into a separate module (carried over from iter 6, not blocking).
Two toast systems coexist (shadcn Toaster + sonner). Both are mounted now which works, but consider consolidating to a single toast system project-wide to avoid future confusion.
